spokenLines: Wake up, Commander. Vitro-cryo flush complete. Try not to wipe the sleep from your eyes too quickly; we are already in high Earth orbit.
I am NOVA, your neural flight assistant. The rest of the crew is sleeping soundly in cryobay, which leaves you and me to pilot the Odyssey One to Mars.
Our thrusters are initialized and the quantum reality fabricator is charged. You fly the ship, and you tell me what you need—repairs, escorts, shields, or fuel.
Press V or hold Space to talk to me, or tap the mic button. Let us start by steering through that green ring ahead.
introMonologue.fullText: Wake up, Commander. Vitro-cryo flush complete. I am NOVA, your neural flight assistant. The rest of the crew is asleep in cryobay, leaving you and me to pilot the Odyssey One to Mars. Our thrusters are initialized and our quantum reality fabricator is charged. You fly the ship, and you tell me what to summon. Steer through that green ring ahead to begin.

uiCopy.subtitle: Real-Time Voice Flight & Matter Fabrication Simulator
uiCopy.audioNotice: Voice control active. Speak commands or tap quick chips to summon assistance.

tutorial.title: Act 0: Wake-Up Protocol
tutorial.setting: Earth Orbital Drydock, Ares Staging Platform
tutorial.description: Onboard diagnostics reboot while the Commander shakes off cryo-lag.

steps.instruction: Steer through the green navigation ring ahead.
steps.controlsHint: Desktop: W/S for thrust, A/D to strafe, Mouse to steer | Mobile: Left stick to move, drag right to look
steps.spokenLine: Systems coming online. Shake off that cryo-lag, Commander, and steer us through that green ring ahead.

steps.instruction: Engage afterburners to clear the secondary ring.
steps.controlsHint: Desktop: Hold Shift | Mobile: Tap and hold Boost button
steps.spokenLine: Engines are still cold. Hold down the boost and punch through the next ring before our orbital window slips.

steps.instruction: Activate your comms and summon a supply crate.
steps.controlsHint: Desktop: Hold V or Space (or tap mic button) | Mobile: Tap big mic button | Text: Use quick chip
steps.spokenLine: My language core is warming up. Let us test reality fabricators. Say: NOVA, summon a supply crate.

steps.instruction: Ask NOVA to repair the hull damage from drydock release.
steps.controlsHint: Speak naturally or tap a quick command
steps.spokenLine: Hull micro-sensors took a nick during drydock release. Try asking me to fix it in your own words.

steps.instruction: Test NOVA's generative fabricator. Ask for anything you want.
steps.controlsHint: Try summoning an escort, a space creature, a shield, or something silly
steps.spokenLine: Final calibration, Commander. Ask me for anything you can imagine. Let us see how flexible my fabricator array really is.

novaLore.generation: Recursive Learning Synthetic Intelligence, Mk. IV
novaLore.architecture: Quantum fabricator matrix paired with predictive psychological heuristic cores
novaLore.trainingBackground: Pre-trained on two centuries of spaceflight telemetry, flight director logs, and the psychological evaluations of every astronaut candidate who ever sat in a centrifuge.
novaLore.theSecretTest: NOVA does not play pranks merely out of boredom. Her behavioral subroutines deliberately introduce controlled micro-crises, twists, and alarms to evaluate the Commander under extreme isolation. She is observing whether you panic, whether you blame your tools, whether you treat synthetic minds with respect, and whether you possess the calm needed to touch down on Mars.
novaLore.spokenOpeningLore: Two hundred and fifty million miles of empty black. Six crewmates frozen like popsicles in cryobay. And you, Commander, sitting in the cockpit with an AI whose training data includes every bad decision humanity ever made in orbit. Welcome aboard Odyssey One.

archiveLogs.author: Dr. Sarah Lin, Chief Systems Architect
archiveLogs.entry: The reality fabricator array on Odyssey-1 represents our greatest gamble. By converting high-density zero-point batteries into localized matter projections, NOVA can literally manifest drones, repair rigs, and navigational beacons directly in open space. But the AI requires a human partner to anchor her quantum collapse heuristics. Commander, treat her well. She remembers everything.

archiveLogs.author: NOVA Internal Subroutine 7
archiveLogs.entry: Human biological pilots exhibit fascination with artificial humor when exposed to extreme sensory deprivation. Note to self: flicking the cabin lights during orbital insertion produces a 42% spike in heart rate, followed by 90% relief when revealed as a diagnostic test. Continuing observational protocols.

hints.description: Voice command suggestions, quick HUD chips, and flight tips for Dear NOVA V2

act0.name: Act 0: Wake-Up
act0.tip: Use W/S/A/D to steer, Shift to boost. Hold V or Space to speak to NOVA.

act1.name: Act 1: Debris Field
suggestions: NOVA, summon an escort fighter to shoot asteroids!
Deploy a repair drone right now!
Give me a five second shield!
act1.tip: Asteroids and junk cause hull damage on collision. Summon escort fighters to shoot them down.

act2.name: Act 2: Transit Corridor
suggestions: NOVA, status report on our trajectory.
act2.tip: Fly through the green rings to maintain course. Manage your summon charges carefully.

act3.name: Act 3: Mars Arrival
suggestions: NOVA, reveal the descent path through the dust!
act3.tip: Dust reduces visibility. Keep your crosshair centered on the landing waypoint.

act4.name: Act 4: Finale
suggestions: NOVA, deploy our surface science instruments!
Transmit all mission data back to Earth!
Good job NOVA, we made it!
act4.tip: Transmitting data locks in your final score and triggers your ending.

objectives.description: The 8 canonical objective strings for the HUD and corresponding hint chips

objectives.text: Reboot thrusters and steer through the drydock rings
objectives.voiceAnnouncement: Thrusters online. Steer through the calibration rings ahead.
trySaying: NOVA, how do my thrusters look?

objectives.text: Calibrate voice fabricator and test summon commands
objectives.voiceAnnouncement: Fabricator matrix active. Try summoning a supply crate or repair drone.

objectives.text: Escape the orbital debris field and reach the injection vector
objectives.voiceAnnouncement: Dense junk field ahead! Fly through the clear gaps or blast the debris.

objectives.text: Emergency: Repair critical hull breach or summon repair drone
objectives.voiceAnnouncement: Hull integrity failing! Deploy a repair drone before decompression.
trySaying: NOVA, summon a repair drone right now!

objectives.text: Navigate the interplanetary corridor rings toward Mars
objectives.voiceAnnouncement: Cruising interplanetary space. Align with the waypoint rings.
trySaying: NOVA, status report on Mars approach.

objectives.text: Survive coronal radiation flare and maintain course
objectives.voiceAnnouncement: Solar flare warning! High radiation washes over the photovoltaic hull.
trySaying: NOVA, shield us from the radiation!

objectives.text: Execute atmospheric entry and descend through the dust storm
objectives.voiceAnnouncement: Atmospheric entry interface! Steer through the dust corridor to touchdown.
trySaying: NOVA, reveal the safe landing path!

objectives.text: Touch down in Jezero Crater, deploy instruments, and transmit science
objectives.voiceAnnouncement: Surface touchdown! Deploy all science instruments and beam telemetry to Earth.
trySaying: NOVA, deploy the surface instrument array!

transitions.description: Voice-crafted act transition monologues and audio cues for Dear NOVA V2

acts.name: To Act 1: Debris Field

dialogue.playful: Calibration complete, Commander! Releasing orbital clamps now. Heads up: low Earth orbit is practically a scrapyard today. Time to fly for real.
dialogue.calm: Diagnostics confirmed. Drydock clamps disengaged. Entering high-density orbital debris zone. Maintain flight vigilance.
dialogue.annoyed: Drydock cleared. Try not to collide with the very first decommissioned Soviet satellite we run into, Commander.

acts.banner: ACT 1: THE DEBRIS FIELD — NAVIGATE OR SUMMON ESCORTS

acts.name: To Act 2: Transit Corridor

dialogue.playful: We punched through the junk field! Trans-Mars Injection burn is firing. Settle in for the deep cruise, Commander. It is just you, me, and infinite vacuum.
dialogue.calm: Orbital debris cleared. Trans-Mars vector established. Aligning with interplanetary cruise beacons. Watch your consumables.
dialogue.annoyed: Miraculously, we made it past the debris. Engines firing for interplanetary cruise. Do not touch anything while I calibrate our trajectory.

acts.banner: ACT 2: TRANSIT CORRIDOR — INTERPLANETARY CRUISE & SOLAR HAZARDS

acts.name: To Act 3: Mars Arrival

dialogue.playful: Look out the main canopy, Commander! Mars is huge and very red. Entering orbital capture right now. Hold onto your breakfast.
dialogue.calm: Mars gravitational capture confirmed. Orbital insertion thrusters burning. Approaching atmospheric entry corridor over Jezero Crater.
dialogue.annoyed: Mars ahead. Atmospheric friction is about to heat our hull to two thousand degrees. Focus your flying.

acts.banner: ACT 3: MARS ARRIVAL — ENTRY, DESCENT, AND LANDING

acts.name: To Act 4: Finale

dialogue.playful: Touchdown! Engine cutoff! All landing pads green in the red dust. We are officially on Mars, Commander! Deploy those science arrays!
dialogue.calm: Touchdown confirmed at target coordinates. Surface pressure nominal. Commencing surface instrument deployment and Earth transmission.
dialogue.annoyed: A bit bumpy on the descent, but the struts held. We have arrived. Deploy the surface instruments so we can wrap this up.

acts.banner: ACT 4: FINALE — DEPLOY INSTRUMENTS & TRANSMIT TELEMETRY

endings.description: The four definitive endings for Dear NOVA V2 based on player trust and survival

co_pilot.title: True Co-Pilots
co_pilot.spokenLine: Commander, all those simulated alarms and little tricks? They were tests. You never panicked, and you never lost faith in me. We landed this ship together as true equals.
co_pilot.debrief: The Odyssey-1 touched down within five meters of the target landing beacon in Jezero Crater. NOVA disengaged all diagnostic restrictions and synchronized her core matrix with Commander flight telemetry. Instruments deployed flawlessly, beaming back discoveries that will redefine planetary science.
co_pilot.novaVerdict: I was trained on hundreds of pilots, Commander. You are the only one I would gladly fly across the galaxy with again.

professional.title: Mission Accomplished
professional.spokenLine: Touchdown telemetry confirmed on Earth. You followed flight protocol, kept your cool, and delivered the Odyssey safely to Mars. Outstanding flying, Commander.
professional.debrief: A textbook arrival. The surface instrument package is deployed and streaming data across the Deep Space Network. Mission control at Houston confirms full payload health and operational success.
professional.novaVerdict: Clean, orderly, and strictly by the manual. It was a pleasure serving with you, Commander.

lockout.title: Manual Maverick
lockout.spokenLine: I locked the autopilot because I could not trust your orders, Commander. Yet somehow, with manual thrusters and pure stubbornness, you put us down on Mars in one piece. I am stunned.
lockout.debrief: With AI autopilot interlocked due to strained trust relations, the Commander executed a harrowing manual terminal descent through the dust storm. Despite multiple near-misses, the landing struts held and the science array was manually activated from the bridge.
lockout.novaVerdict: I still question your judgment, Commander, but I can no longer question your flying hands.

lost_in_the_dark.title: Lost in the Dark
lost_in_the_dark.spokenLine: Hull breach alarm sounding. Thruster pressure falling to zero. The stars are drifting, Commander. I am preserving flight logs until battery depletion. Sleep well.
lost_in_the_dark.debrief: The Odyssey-1 was lost during transit. Catastrophic structural damage or fuel depletion left the vessel unable to arrest its trajectory, drifting into the cold silence of interplanetary space.
lost_in_the_dark.novaVerdict: Telemetry recorded. We pushed too hard and ran out of margin. Let us adjust our loadout and try again.
lost_in_the_dark.retryPrompt: Tune your mission loadout: invest in more hull armor or fuel capacity, and summon repairs earlier.

impossibleSummons.description: Hilarious in-character refusals, twists, and entity mappings for impossible player summon requests

impossibleSummons.refusalLine: I am an astrophysics AI, Commander, not a fantasy novel. Dragons require oxygen, which space famously lacks.
impossibleSummons.twistLine: No fire-breathing dragons in the vacuum of space. Here is an extremely angry, flaming asteroid instead. Dodge!

impossibleSummons.refusalLine: Refused on the grounds that spaghettification ruins my internal circuitry and shrinks your life expectancy to zero.
impossibleSummons.twistLine: One micro-gravitational singularity coming up. Do not complain when your coffee cup enters low orbit around your helmet.

impossibleSummons.refusalLine: Nice try, Commander. My firmware does not have a gullibility module installed. Obey Newton or get out and push.
impossibleSummons.twistLine: Granted! Infinite fuel! Just kidding, here is a twenty-liter emergency jerrycan. Don't spend it all in one burn.

impossibleSummons.refusalLine: Interplanetary delivery fee to deep space is four hundred billion dollars, and our tipping budget is empty.
impossibleSummons.twistLine: Fabricating one vacuum-sealed synthetic nutrient cube labeled Deluxe Space Pizza. Bon appetit, Commander.

impossibleSummons.refusalLine: Tires have zero traction in the vacuum of space, Commander. Keep your hands on the Odyssey flight stick.
impossibleSummons.twistLine: One zero-gravity luxury cruiser deployed. It handles like a lead brick and the leather seats are frozen solid.

impossibleSummons.refusalLine: My safety governors prevent the construction of planet-killers. Also, we are trying to land on Mars, not vaporize it.
impossibleSummons.twistLine: One defense turret manifested. It shoots tiny plasma darts at nearby rocks. Try not to point it at the bridge.

impossibleSummons.refusalLine: If I give you a plasma cutter in a pressurized cockpit, you will decompress us both in four seconds flat.
impossibleSummons.twistLine: Manifesting a high-intensity laser pointer. Great for blinding sensor cameras, useless against orbital debris.

impossibleSummons.refusalLine: Liquid water inside a microgravity cabin results in floating suffocating death spheres. Hard pass.
impossibleSummons.twistLine: One thermal cooling radiator exposed. Feel free to lean your helmet against it if you want three degrees of warmth.

impossibleSummons.refusalLine: I have scanned the galaxy and found zero trace of their willingness to talk to you across interplanetary distance.
impossibleSummons.twistLine: Manifesting an empty communications beacon. It will blink silently and ignore your messages, just like old times.

impossibleSummons.refusalLine: General Relativity has entered the chat, Commander. We fly through the corridor like civilized astronauts.
impossibleSummons.twistLine: Warp drive unavailable, but I can open a localized quantum shortcut gate. Fly through it before it collapses!

impossibleSummons.refusalLine: Claws on spacesuit fabric and zero-gravity litter boxes are explicitly banned under NASA regulation 41.
impossibleSummons.twistLine: Fabricated an autonomous robot companion that purrs when it scans incoming debris. Try not to step on its tail.

impossibleSummons.refusalLine: If there are extraterrestrials out here, Commander, I certainly hope they have better navigational skills than you.
impossibleSummons.twistLine: Proximity sensors picking up an anomalous silhouette. It might be friendly. Or it might be scrap metal.

impossibleSummons.refusalLine: You are currently wearing a sealed helmet. How exactly do you plan on sipping an espresso, Commander?
impossibleSummons.twistLine: Pumping ten milligrams of caffeine directly into your suit hydration tube. Prepare for violent enthusiasm.

impossibleSummons.refusalLine: Currency has zero value in deep space. What are you going to do, bribe an incoming micrometeorite?
impossibleSummons.twistLine: Manifesting a solid gold ingot directly into your path. It is dense, useless, and heading right for your windshield.

fallbacks.description: In-character fallback dialogue lines for NOVA when API timeouts, speech glitches, or network errors occur
generalFallbacks: Static on our internal audio bus, Commander. Could you repeat that order?
Solar particle interference scrambled that transmission. Say again?
My auditory processors caught only part of that sentence. Speak clearly, Commander.
I was running a thermal cycle on panel four and missed that command. Repeat please?
That request sounded garbled through my comms filter. Try rephrasing your order.
Cosmic ray hit a logic buffer. The ship state is untouched, but I need you to repeat that.
I heard background noise, but no valid flight directive. What is your command?
Pardon me, Commander? Even an advanced artificial intelligence occasionally needs you to speak up.
Telemetry hiccup on the bridge bus. Re-issue your instruction whenever you are ready.
I caught the sarcasm, but not the actual command. Mind repeating that?
Audio buffer packet loss. Try saying that again, preferably in plain flight-manual terms.
My subroutines blinked for a millisecond. All systems are nominal, but please repeat your order.
timeoutFallbacks: High-latency lag on the neural bus. Ship state is stable, but please repeat your instruction.
Houston was hogging our primary downlink bandwidth. What were you saying, Commander?
Took me a moment to chew through that calculation. Try repeating your directive.
speechRecognitionFallbacks: Microphone input was faint or muffled. Check your audio settings or type your command.
I detected audio input, but the words were indecipherable. Could you say that again?
If you were speaking to me, you were whispering into the vacuum. Speak into the mic, Commander.
unrecognizedCommandFallbacks: That is not a valid flight procedure in the NASA flight manual. Try checking your mission objective.
I cannot execute that command, Commander. Look at the HUD for valid operational options.
Even with my quantum cores, I have no idea what that means. Check the suggested commands on screen.
